title: The Unwritten Compass
author: Gideon Dunmore
blurb: Freya Fairweather, a mapmaker's apprentice finishing the atlas the master died for, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then a stranger arrives carrying unmistakable handwriting from a supposed corpse — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must keep a promise made in peacetime to someone now declared enemy, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
